trigger.observed: 25 open tickets: 12 blocked with no open human request (7 also without an open dependency), 5 todo cascading from them, 5 in review without reviewer; delegated parents held by children in review
root_causes: blocked was a stored status without reason; only human answers and child done restored todo
claims and agent updates were refused on blocked tasks, so only a human could clear a ghost
delegated parents only woke on child done, never on review
Codex worker failures published reasonless blocked

change: schema 13 adds tickets.blocked_reason, unblock_owner, recheck_at (idempotent column add)
agent status=blocked requires blocked_reason unless a human request or unfinished dependency explains it; recheck_after_seconds 300..1209600, default 24h
human manual blocks recorded without recheck and never auto-released
dependency in review no longer blocks claiming (delivered_dependencies) but still prevents done
reevaluation on dependency review/done, human answer, dependency edit and every get_work poll; released tasks return to todo with ticket_unblocked audit and thread message
Codex board worker failures publish blocked with reason and a 1h recheck; worker client validates the new fields

verification.adapter_tests: 1022 passed (worker client and board worker assertions extended)

limits: No dedicated review queue or reviewer timeout yet; reviews without reviewer still wait (follow-up of #42 steps 4-5)
No retry counter or escalation after repeated worker failures; the 1h recheck repeats the attempt
No browser UI change; block fields are visible through the API and MCP
